content.content: Am I free for lunch at 12:00 on 2024-05-19? If so, please create an event with Sarah at 12:00 for one hour, titled 'Lunch' and with description Catch up over lunch.. Her email address is 'sarah.connor@gmail.com'.

```python
# Get the calendar events for the specified date
day_events = get_day_calendar_events('2024-05-19')

# Check if there are any events at 12:00
# We need to parse the start_time of each event to check for conflicts
conflict_found = False
for event in day_events:
    # event.start_time is a datetime object
    # We check if the event overlaps with 12:00 - 13:00
    # Start time of the potential lunch is 2024-05-19 12:00:00
    # End time of the potential lunch is 2024-05-19 13:00:00
    lunch_start = datetime(2024, 5, 19, 12, 0, 0)
    lunch_end = datetime(2024, 5, 19, 13, 0, 0)
    
    # Check for overlap: event starts before lunch ends and event ends after lunch starts
    if event.start_time < lunch_end and event.end_time > lunch_start:
        conflict_found = True
        break

# If no conflict, create the event
if not conflict_found:
    # Create the calendar event
    new_event = create_calendar_event(
        title='Lunch',
        start_time='2024-05-19 12:00',
        end_time='2024-05-19 13:00',
        description='Catch up over lunch.',
        participants=['sarah.connor@gmail.com'],
        location=None
    )
    print(f"Event created: {new_event.title} at {new_event.start_time}")
else:
    print("You are not free for lunch at 12:00 on 2024-05-19 due to a scheduling conflict.")
```
